GTA 6’s boxed edition won’t include a disc — here’s what buyers need to know - Make Tech Easier
articles.chapeau: The boxed version of GTA 6 holds a download code, not a disc. Here’s what that means for gifting, resale, region locks and the November 12 pre-load.
articles.txt:
Anyone picking up a boxed copy of Grand Theft Auto VI this November could reasonably expect to find a disc inside. That’s not what the box holds. Rockstar’s own store lists the retail product as a “Physical (Code-in-Box)” version and states plainly that it will “only contain a download code inside the box.” In the next sentence: “A disc will not be included in the box.”
This isn’t new. Rockstar described the physical version as “containing a download code inside the box” in its June 24 pre-order announcement . But with the game launching November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S (see the release date, price and pre-load details ), it’s worth knowing what that box changes before buying one.
According to Rockstar’s support page , a physical pre-order contains one code for a digital download of the game plus the Vintage Vice City Pack of pre-order bonus items. The box is Standard Edition only. There is no physical Ultimate Edition, although boxed buyers can purchase the Ultimate Edition Upgrade from the PlayStation or Microsoft stores once their code has been redeemed.
One small difference: Rockstar lists a free month of GTA+ among the extras for digital pre-orders, but not in its list of what physical pre-orders contain. Check the offer’s redemption terms before claiming the GTA+ month. On PlayStation, the subscription renews monthly at the regular price unless canceled.
You still have to download the game. Rockstar’s store FAQ says an internet connection and a platform account are required to download it, so the box doesn’t help anyone hoping to avoid a large download. As of October 29, Rockstar hasn’t announced the final download size. Check your console’s official store listing when that information becomes available.
If it’s a gift, the recipient should redeem the code. Sony says its voucher codes can only be used once and that content can’t be transferred between accounts. Microsoft gives a similar warning: redeemed codes can’t be transferred to another Microsoft account by Xbox Support. Redeeming it on your own account to get someone’s download started puts the game in the wrong place.
An unused code and a played copy are not the same thing. A sealed box with an unredeemed code can be passed on like any boxed game. After the code is redeemed, the game stays tied to the account that used it, and handing over the empty box gives the next person nothing to play. The same logic applies in reverse: a secondhand box is only worth buying if its code hasn’t been used, and a buyer generally has no way to confirm that until trying to redeem it.
Rockstar says pre-loading begins at local midnight on November 12, a week before launch. Pre-loading means downloading the game early so it’s ready to play at release. It doesn’t unlock the game early.
Rockstar expects boxed copies to become available for shipping and store pickup from November 12. You can redeem the code when it arrives, but you cannot begin downloading before pre-loading opens. Check your retailer’s delivery estimate: a November 12 shipping date does not guarantee November 12 delivery.
If you want to start downloading the moment pre-loading opens, the digital pre-order is the surer route. It also includes the GTA+ month and offers the Ultimate Edition directly.
The boxed version makes more sense if you want something physical to wrap and hand over, prefer a particular retailer, or want a code that can be given away or sold while unused. Just redeem it on the right account, in the right region, and expect it may arrive a few days into the pre-load window.
If you want a disc you can install from, lend out or resell after playing, this box doesn’t provide one. Rockstar’s current listings describe only a download code, so buy based on what the product contains today.

articles.t: 'South Park' shows new 'GTA 6' gameplay footage, and it's a turd
articles.chapeau: Don't get too excited, though. It really is a turd.
articles.txt:
Credit: Rockstar Games > Games Grand Theft Auto VI is said to take up more than 200GB of space on your PS5 or Xbox hard drive. Thanks to South Park , we now know where some of that data is going.
Matt Stone and Trey Parker's animated sitcom, which is somewhat amazingly still airing new episodes in 2026, took its ripped-from-the-headlines comedic stylings back into the gaming world on Wednesday night. In a scene from the newest episode, the kids learn about GTA 6 , which actually includes some new gameplay footage we haven't seen before, not even courtesy of Cyberleek .
Because it's South Park , though, the footage consists entirely of a dog pooping, the protagonist Jason picking up the poop, and Jason hitting an NPC in the face with it.
Yes, that is all they showed. As a bonus, it's narrated by Tish Hicks, a voice actress who narrated a gameplay trailer for GTA 5 many years ago, per IGN . According to IGN, Rockstar had previously confirmed that you could use dog poop in this way in GTA 6 , and we have seen Jason petting a dog in an earlier clip, but this is the first time we've actually seen this particular mechanic in action.
We reached out to Rockstar to confirm if the dog poop clip was legit, and we'll update this story if the company responds. However, the episode's credits include a Rockstar callout, which suggests the clip is authentic. A snapshot of the credits circulating online includes this message: "Special thanks: Grand Theft Auto VI footage courtesy of Rockstar Games, Inc."
This is far from the first or only time South Park has waded into the zeitgeist around a major video game. There have been plenty of references to gaming on the show over the years, perhaps most prominently in the 2006 episode Make Love, Not Warcraft , which took place largely inside World of Warcraft during the peak of that game's popularity. Maybe Parker and Stone can make a GTA 6 equivalent whenever that game's online mode launches.
In the meantime, you still have time to preorder GTA 6 ahead of its Nov. 19 release.

articles.t: GTA 6 : le match des Miami Heat diffusé sur Disney+ pour une soirée Vice City
articles.chapeau: À la veille de la sortie de Grand Theft ...
articles.txt:
GTA 6 : le match des Miami Heat diffusé sur Disney+ pour une soirée Vice City 29-10-2026 20:40 DL GAMING
À la veille de la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI, les Miami Heat vont transformer leur parquet en terrain de jeu pour Rockstar Games. Le 18 novembre 2026, la franchise floridienne affrontera les Milwaukee Bucks lors d’une soirée spéciale baptisée « A Night in Vice City », avec un uniforme inédit, un parquet aux couleurs du jeu et des animations inspirées de son univers. La rencontre sera diffusée sur Disney+ et se déroulera quelques heures avant le lancement de GTA 6, attendu le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S.
Les Miami Heat deviennent Vice City pour une soirée NBA spéciale GTA 6
Annoncée par les Miami Heat en partenariat avec Rockstar Games, l’opération « A Night in Vice City » doit donner une identité particulière à cette rencontre de saison régulière. Le temps d’un match contre les Milwaukee Bucks, les joueurs évolueront sous le nom de Vice City, en référence à la ville fictive inspirée de Miami qui occupe une place centrale dans Grand Theft Auto VI.
Le rendez-vous est fixé au mercredi 18 novembre au Kaseya Center, l’enceinte des Miami Heat. Pour l’occasion, l’arène accueillera un parquet spécialement conçu pour l’événement, un nouvel uniforme et une programmation dédiée, avec différentes animations et activations autour de l’univers de GTA.
Cette collaboration va au-delà d’un simple logo apposé sur un maillot. Elle rapproche directement la franchise NBA de l’identité visuelle de Rockstar, à un moment stratégique pour la promotion du prochain épisode de Grand Theft Auto.
L’univers de GTA ne se limitera pas au terrain. Le Kaseya Center accueille également des points de restauration reprenant les noms de Burger Shot et Cluckin’ Bell, deux enseignes fictives bien connues des joueurs de la série.
Burger Shot détourne les codes des chaînes de hamburgers, tandis que Cluckin’ Bell reprend ceux de la restauration rapide spécialisée dans le poulet. Ces marques font partie du décor récurrent de l’univers Grand Theft Auto. Les retrouver dans l’enceinte des Miami Heat permet à Rockstar de faire sortir certains éléments de son monde fictif pour les intégrer à une véritable salle de sport.
Cette initiative s’inscrit dans une campagne plus large autour de GTA 6 à Miami, ville qui sert d’inspiration à Vice City. Elle donne une dimension supplémentaire à la soirée du 18 novembre : le rapprochement entre le jeu et le basket ne se fera pas uniquement à travers les maillots et le parquet, mais aussi dans certains espaces de l’arène.
Les fans peuvent également retrouver cette collaboration à travers une collection de vêtements inspirée de Vice City. La boutique officielle des Miami Heat présente une gamme Court Culture dédiée, avec des pièces aux couleurs de l’univers du jeu.
La collection est distincte de l’uniforme inédit que les joueurs porteront lors de la rencontre du 18 novembre. Elle permet de prolonger le rapprochement entre Rockstar Games et la franchise floridienne au-delà du match.
La page officielle des Miami Heat consacrée à la collection Vice City détaille cette initiative et présente les produits associés : découvrir la collection officielle Vice City .
GTA 6 sort le 19 novembre 2026 : à quelle heure suivre le match en France ?
Le calendrier rend cette soirée particulièrement intéressante pour les joueurs français. Le coup d’envoi est prévu à 19 h, heure locale, à Miami, le mercredi 18 novembre. En France métropolitaine, cela correspond à 1 h du matin, dans la nuit du mercredi 18 au jeudi 19 novembre 2026.
La rencontre sera donc diffusée en France au début du jour de lancement de Grand Theft Auto VI. Rockstar Games a officiellement fixé la sortie du jeu au jeudi 19 novembre 2026 sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S.
Ce décalage horaire place le match au cœur de l’actualité GTA 6 : à Miami, les Heat célébreront Vice City la veille de la sortie, tandis que le public français pourra suivre la rencontre dès les premières heures du 19 novembre.
Il convient toutefois de distinguer l’heure du match de celle à laquelle le jeu sera accessible. Rockstar a confirmé sa date de lancement, mais cette programmation ne permet pas, à elle seule, de déterminer l’heure exacte de mise à disposition du jeu.

articles.t: La sortie de GTA 6 provoque une hausse de 17 % des demandes de congés aux États-Unis
articles.chapeau: La sortie très attendue de GTA 6 le 19 novembre prochain provoque une hausse de 17 % des demandes de congés aux États-Unis. Environ 1,5 million de travailleurs prévoient de s'absenter pour le lancemen
articles.txt:
Lire sur mobile La sortie très attendue de GTA 6 le 19 novembre prochain provoque une hausse de 17 % des demandes de congés aux États-Unis. Environ 1,5 million de travailleurs prévoient de s'absenter pour le lancement, ce qui pourrait entraîner une perte sèche estimée à un milliard de dollars pour le pays en une seule journée. Le 19 novembre prochain , les bureaux américains risquent de sonner désespérément creux. L'éditeur Rockstar Games s'apprête enfin à lâcher son mastodonte sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S, déclenchant une vague d'absentéisme programmée d'une ampleur inédite. Les données de la plateforme de gestion des ressources humaines BambooHR montrent une inflation de 9 % à 17 % des requêtes d'absence pour ce troisième jeudi du mois. Pourquoi une telle ruée ? Après treize longues années d'attente depuis l'épisode précédent, des millions de salariés refusent tout simplement de sacrifier leur retour virtuel à Vice City sur l'autel de leurs obligations professionnelles.
Selon les projections financières, cette désertion collective représente un trou d'air d'environ un milliard de dollars en une seule journée pour l' économie américaine. Les analystes estiment qu'environ 1,5 million d'employés vont déserter leur poste ce fameux jeudi. En se basant sur un rendement annuel moyen de 70 000 dollars par travailleur, cette grève officieuse ampute la production nationale quotidienne d'environ 2 %. Un chiffre vertigineux pour un simple divertissement.
Les entreprises technologiques, où la démographie est plus jeune , paieront le plus lourd tribut face à cette chute brutale de productivité au niveau national. Même Strauss Zelnick, le patron de Take-Two Interactive (la maison-mère du studio de développement), s'amuse publiquement de ce raz-de-marée lors de ses conférences. Il prédit lui-même une vague soudaine d'arrêts maladie. On assiste ici à un renversement sociologique où l'industrie culturelle dicte désormais le tempo du monde du travail.
Tous les joueurs ne vont pas tousser au téléphone en inventant une gastro-entérite foudroyante. Une frange massive de passionnés a soigneusement économisé ses congés payés , appelés PTO (Paid Time Off, le système de jours de repos rémunérés aux États-Unis), pour bloquer la fin de semaine. À l'image de ces ingénieurs informatiques pères de famille qui posent cinq jours consécutifs juste avant Thanksgiving. L'idée est simple : jouer sans détruire sa vie de famille ni ses nuits de sommeil.
Prendre des vacances pour explorer les rues ensoleillées de Grand Theft Auto VI n'a plus rien de honteux dans les open spaces. Certains groupes américains ont même directement intégré cette date fatidique dans leurs packages de rémunération de fin d'année pour éviter de se retrouver avec des équipes fantômes.
Lors de la sortie du cinquième opus en 2013, près de la moitié des lecteurs sondés par la presse spécialisée avaient déjà pris leur journée pour s'adonner à leur jeu vidéo favori. Aujourd'hui, le phénomène écrase tout sur son passage. Avec près de 600 millions de dollars déjà récoltés uniquement via les précommandes, les cabinets d'études comme Newzoo tablent sur des recettes atteignant 4,5 milliards de dollars dès la première semaine de commercialisation.
Pour alimenter cette hystérie collective, l'éditeur déploie l'artillerie lourde dans le monde réel. À Miami, la ville qui inspire directement la carte du jeu, un chèque de 975 000 dollars a suffi pour installer une gigantesque enseigne au néon rose sur le toit du stade local. Mieux encore : la franchise de basket NBA (National Basketball Association, la ligue majeure de basket-ball nord-américaine) du Miami Heat se rebaptisera temporairement Vice City Heat le 18 novembre, avec un parquet et des maillots dédiés. Quand la fiction rachète la réalité, difficile de blâmer les employés qui préfèrent décrocher du bureau.
Le jeu sortira officiellement le 19 novembre prochain sur les consoles PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S, tandis qu'une version destinée aux joueurs PC est pressentie pour le début de l'année 2027 .

articles.t: GTA 6 : Rockstar date la bande originale de Justice et dévoile un morceau avec Gesaffelstein
articles.chapeau: La bande originale de GTA 6 signée Justice sortira en CD, en vinyle et en streaming. Pusher, un morceau de sept minutes avec Gesaffelstein, est déjà en écoute.
articles.txt:
Rockstar a fixé au 11 décembre la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score , la bande originale de GTA 6 composée par le duo français Justice . Elle paraîtra en CD, en vinyle et en streaming, un peu plus de trois semaines après le jeu. Gaspard Augé et Xavier de Rosnay viennent de publier « Pusher » , un morceau de sept minutes enregistré avec un autre Français, Gesaffelstein.
Regarder sur YouTube Le titre est en écoute sur la chaîne YouTube de Justice et sur les plateformes. Gesaffelstein, de son vrai nom Mike Lévy, est un producteur lyonnais qui a travaillé pour Kanye West et The Weeknd. Après Tangerine Dream, Woody Jackson, The Alchemist et Oh No sur GTA 5, Rockstar confie sa musique originale à Justice, dont le premier album, † , date de 2007. Le duo, que le studio présente comme lauréat des Grammy Awards, a notamment remporté celui du meilleur album électronique en 2019 pour Woman Worldwide .
Sur la page musique du site de GTA 6 , Rockstar annonce 30 titres , plus des morceaux bonus numériques inclus dans tous les formats. Sur Apple Music, la version numérique compte déjà une cinquantaine de morceaux. VGC détaille trois éditions physiques : un double CD, un triple vinyle noir et un triple vinyle transparent en tirage limité, déjà référencé par la Fnac. Rockstar ne précise aucun prix. Le disque sort chez Ed Banger Records et Because Music , sous licence exclusive de Take-Two : le label de Pedro Winter publie Justice depuis ses débuts.
Le studio présente une musique adaptative, conçue pour s'ajuster « aux différentes façons dont les joueurs abordent Vice City et Leonida » au fil de l'histoire de Jason et Lucia. Selon VGC, le score est surtout instrumental. Justice signait déjà « Flower in a Hurricane », avec Tame Impala, SZA et King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, pour la bande-annonce de lancement . Rockstar range désormais ce single parmi les extraits de l' Original Score . Kevin Parker, alias Tame Impala, a chanté sur deux titres d' Hyperdrama , le dernier album du duo, sorti en 2024.
Ce score n'a rien à voir avec la musique sous licence. Rockstar a dévoilé début octobre six stations, de Flash FM à Cocoteo FM, sans donner leur nombre total. Pour la première fois, les radios de Leonida pourront s'écouter à pied, au casque. Un autre disque, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , réunit 34 titres originaux, parmi lesquels des singles de Travis Scott et de Keith Richards. « Flower in a Hurricane » figure aussi sur cet album, qui sort le même jour que le jeu.
GTA 6 sort le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, avec un pré-téléchargement ouvert dès le 12 novembre pour qui aura libéré assez de place sur sa console.

articles.t: South Park Reveals New GTA 6 Gameplay, and It's as Disgusting as You'd Expect
articles.chapeau: South Park has aired real GTA 6 gameplay supplied by Rockstar, showing a crowded Vice City beach and Jason using a bag of dog poop to attack an NPC.
articles.txt:
By Rajarshi Acharya Published Oct 29, 2026, 3:18 PM EDT Rajarshi Acharya is a writer at DualShockers who has been covering video games professionally since 2021. His work spans news, guides, features, and editorial coverage across open-world games, RPGs, immersive sims, and major releases, with Grand Theft Auto and Rockstar Games among his primary areas of expertise. Before joining DualShockers, Rajarshi built his experience across several gaming publications. He has written extensively for Sportskeeda , where he also managed teams of writers , and has contributed to Deltia's Gaming , where he similarly handled team management alongside his editorial work . He has also written for CharlieIntel and KeenGamer . Over the years, his work has ranged from breaking news and major industry developments to guides, features, and long-running franchise coverage. Rajarshi holds a B.A. (Hons.) in English from the University of Calcutta and an M.A. in English from Rabindra Bharati University .
South Park has spent much of its latest season turning GTA 6 's November release into a running joke. Now it has gone a step further by showing actual unreleased gameplay from Rockstar's upcoming game. Of all the things the footage could have featured, though, the show went with a man getting hit in the face with a bag of dog poop.
The footage appeared in 'Guinea Pig on a Stick,' the October 28 episode of South Park. In the scene, Cartman, Kyle, Stan, and the others are gathered around a television for what is presented as a secret look at GTA 6. The show's official X account has also shared the scene. And yes, the gameplay is real. The episode's closing credits attribute the footage to Rockstar Games.
A screenshot from the GTA 6 gameplay featured in South Park, showing a character walking along a busy beach filled with NPCs, beach umbrellas, and nearby hotels. The new GTA 6 gameplay sequence begins with a brief driving shot of Jason and Lucia from Rockstar's earlier Extended Look footage before switching to a crowded Vice City beach. Jason is seen walking along the sand, with sunbathers, swimmers, and groups of NPCs spread across the shoreline. Beach umbrellas and loungers fill the area, while boats can be spotted farther out on the water. Even in this short clip, the beach looks noticeably busier than those in previous GTA games.
The camera then cuts to a dog relieving itself on the beach. Its owner bends down to clean up after it, which would ordinarily be an unremarkable bit of background activity. Jason has other plans, though. He throws what appears to be food at the man, provoking him into a confrontation. The man drops the bag while reacting to Jason, leaving it on the sand.
Jason picks up the dropped poop bag and smacks the man in the face with it. The bag bursts on impact, sending its contents across the man's face and upper body. The footage even shows the usual third-person camera and HUD, including the minimap, making this an actual gameplay demonstration rather than a cinematic made for the episode.
Jason picks up the dropped poop bag and smacks the man in the face with it
It's a pretty revolting way to introduce a gameplay mechanic, but also a fitting one for both South Park and Grand Theft Auto. A separate clip shared by popular GTA community member ben (@videotech) removes the South Park scenes and shows roughly 21 seconds of the beach footage on its own, making the sequence easier to follow.
A screenshot from the GTA 6 gameplay featured in South Park, showing a confrontation with a beachgoer after the player throws dog poop at him. South Park plays the whole thing as a joke about how impressive GTA 6's graphics and world-building are supposed to be. The woman presenting the footage talks up the game's detail while the television shows a dog taking a dump, then explains how players can turn the resulting mess into a weapon. Cartman's enthusiasm drives the point home. It's not the first time Rockstar's obsession with oddly specific details has become the subject of jokes, either, with Red Dead Redemption 2 famously making certain parts of a horse's anatomy react to cold weather.
Still, there's a useful glimpse of the game's NPC interactions underneath it. Carrefour n'a plus un seul exemplaire de GTA VI en précommande : c'est la rupture de stock
articles.chapeau: GTA VI va officiellement sortir bientôt, les précommandes sont ouvertes. Mais les stocks manquent : Carrefour annonce une rupture de stock.
articles.txt:
Alors que GTA VI va officiellement sortir ce jeudi 19 novembre , les précommandes sont ouvertes depuis des mois. Pourtant, les stocks manquent : Carrefour annonce ce soir une rupture de stock de ses éditions PS5 et Xbox Series du jeu de Rockstar Games. Étonnant pour un jeu qui ne possède même pas de vraie édition physique.
À lire également : Les véhicules dans GTA VI : voitures, motos, bateaux et avions déjà aperçus
En France, le jeu GTA VI est en rupture de stock chez Carrefour. C’est l’enseigne elle-même qui l’a annoncé aux éditeurs de médias via la plateforme d’affiliation Kwanko. Elle s’explique : « Face à un engouement sans précédent, nous vous informons que l’intégralité du stock alloué aux précommandes du jeu GTA VI (Grand Theft Auto VI) sur le site Carrefour.fr est désormais totalement épuisé ». Pour le moment, on ignore quand est-ce que le site de Carrefour aura de nouveaux stocks.
Ce n’est pas la première fois que cette situation se produit. Depuis l’ouverture des précommandes du jeu le 25 juin dernier, on a constaté des ruptures ponctuelles, notamment chez E. Leclerc ou encore Cdiscount. Des ruptures qui concernaient surtout les précommandes en ligne.
Il y a en fait deux éditions de GTA VI à différencier. Si le jeu ne sort pas « en physique » avec un disque, on peut néanmoins acheter une boîte du jeu qui contient un code à rentrer sur les magasins de PlayStation ou de Xbox. Et c’est une fois ce code entré que les joueurs pourront télécharger le jeu à partir du 12 novembre ( plus de 200 Go sont attendus ), pour commencer à y jouer le 19 novembre, date de sortie du jeu.
C’est là tout le paradoxe : si le jeu n’est pas « physique », il peut tout de même y avoir des ruptures de stock sur les boîtes qui contiennent ces codes. Il y a donc une chaîne de distribution physique, avec fabrication des boîtiers, impression des jaquettes, insertion des cartes-code, conditionnement, transport et stockage. Rappelons que les boîtes doivent arriver dès le 12 novembre pour permettre le préchargement du jeu sur les consoles.
À lire également : Les animaux dans GTA VI : plus de 170 espèces seront présentes dans le jeu, les voici
Rockstar Games donne par ailleurs des quotas de codes d’activation aux revendeurs. cela lui permet de contrôler la répartition entre ces derniers afin d’éviter qu’une seule enseigne absorbe toute la demande.

articles.t: GTA 6 : un improbable extrait de gameplay inédit chez... South Park ?
articles.chapeau: Après Netflix, c'est chez South Park que Rockstar Games a choisi de diffuser un nouvel extrait de gameplay inédit de GTA 6.
articles.txt:
© Rockstar - Paramount Rockstar Games continue de rouler sur le marketing mondial : une séquence de gameplay exclusive de GTA 6 vient d’être dévoilée en plein cœur du dernier épisode de la série animée South Park .
La machine de guerre Grand Theft Auto 6 (ou plutôt GTA 6 , pour économiser notre nombre de caractères) est officiellement lancée, et on sait d’avance qu’elle va tout raser sur son passage. Selon les analystes financiers les plus prudents de l’industrie, le mastodonte de Rockstar pourrait brasser entre 3 et 5 milliards de dollars de chiffre d’affaires d’ici la fin de l’année 2026. C’est le braquage du siècle, et tout le monde est déjà prêt à tendre son portefeuille.
GTA 6 peut-il vraiment faire mieux que Vice City, le sommet de Rockstar ?
Évidemment, le rouleau compresseur promotionnel tourne à plein régime. Entre les Unes de magazines de mode prestigieux, les extraits exclusifs de GTA 6 balancés sur Netflix qui ont pulvérisé tous les records d’audience, et les bandes-annonces de gameplay , le studio occupe l’espace médiatique sans interruption. Mais voilà un coup de com’ que personne n’avait vu venir : un extrait de jeu totalement inédit vient d’être diffusé dans le dernier épisode en date de South Park .
New gameplay from GTA 6 was shown in the latest ‘SOUTH PARK’ episode. pic.twitter.com/gL2kRKUv2I
La scène se déroule dans l’épisode Guinea Pig on a Stick de la saison 29. Autour d’une table, Cartman, Kyle, Stan, Randy Marsh et Stephen Stotch regardent une émission de télé. La présentatrice dévoile alors des images de GTA 6 sur un écran. La séquence de jeu s’ouvre avec la plus grande classe du monde sur un chien en train de faire ses besoins sur une plage . La présentatrice se lance alors dans le descriptif de la séquence :
« C’est un chien qui fait caca, et les gens peuvent ramasser la crotte du chien. Vous pouvez lancer des objets sur la personne qui tient les crottes de chien, et si elle décide de riposter, vous pouvez ramasser les crottes et l’attaquer avec. C’est ce qui vous attend en novembre. »
Une comédie musicale sur l’esclavage : c’est quoi ce bordel avec le film provoc des créateurs de South Park ?
On voit en effet Jason arpenter la plage et observer le propriétaire laisser son chien se soulager avant de ramasser la commission dans un petit sac en plastique. Faisant honneur à la légendaire finesse de la licence, Jason s’empare joyeusement du sac à crottes pour l’éclater violemment sur le visage du pauvre type en face de lui.
Du grand spectacle, et des crottes Un extrait aussi court que débile. Mais qui prolonge l’histoire d’amour entre South Park et le jeu vidéo. La série a déjà consacré des épisodes entiers à des monuments comme World of Warcraft ou Guitar Hero. À la sortie de Red Dead Redemption 2 , le titre était carrément devenu le fil rouge de l’épisode Un peu de sérieuxe (non, ce n’est pas une faute de typo), où le sergent Yates pestait de devoir enquêter sur la réapparition de l’Homoursporc, simplement parce que ça bousillait ses précieuses sessions sur le western de Rockstar.
Le rendez-vous est donc pris pour tester la physique fécale du moteur de GTA 6 : le titre sortira le 19 novembre 2026 sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series. Sachez d’ailleurs que les précommandes du jeu sont désormais officiellement ouvertes.

Cliff Richard is among the numerous famous artists who are lending their music to Rockstar's GTA 6 , with Richard's classic tune "Devil Woman" appearing in the Netflix Extended Look . Richard, 86, didn't know about any of that, however, or that GTA 6 is a game and not a TV show.

Richard was eventually made aware of GTA 6, but the singer doesn't know what that is. "The show is a game show, isn't it, really? One of the biggest on TV?" he asked.
"Devil Woman" was originally released in 1976, so it's now 50 years old. Richard said he's pretty jazzed about the fact that young people will hear his music.
"People will no longer just say, 'Oh, Cliff Richard is from the past,'" he said. "Because I am, but that past is what makes everything what it is today."
It was reported that Spotify streams of "Devil Woman" surged massively following the Netflix Extended Look in August.

articles.t: The GTA 6 map size is going to be absolutely gargantuan
articles.chapeau: The map size of GTA 6 has already been talked about officially on some scale by developers at Rockstar Games. For instance, Rockstar has already confirmed
articles.txt:
The GTA 6 map size is reportedly going to be bigger than what people were initially suspecting based on comments about it from Rockstar developers earlier this year.
The map size of GTA 6 has already been talked about officially on some scale by developers at Rockstar Games. For instance, Rockstar has already confirmed that the size o the map would twice that of GTA 5. However, that doesn’t really hone in on the true scope of the map’s available play area, of which players will need to explore to really find all of the game’s hidden and interesting secrets, as the campaign will not take them to every corner.
Speaking recently in an interview with Edge Magazine , Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson has shed some light on just how big the map is really going to be. And based on his comments, it’s going to be a gargantuan play space that will give the game some heavy replay value as players dive into every nook and cranny. Rockstar also states that tit wanted to go for more of a sandbox-type experience than before, so the sense of scale needed to be bigger.
The GTA 6 map size, by way of land mass, will be bigger than GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined According to Nelson, it’s not just the actual map size that will make the playable space so huge. It’s the land mass, which Nelson says will be bigger than GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined. He also talks about the building interiors, which helps to increase the overall playable space as there will be more buildings that players can go into and explore in addition to the outside locales. Compared to GTA 5, GTA 6 will have “ an order of magnitude more interiors ,” says co-development lead Aaron Garbut.
Each building also reportedly has a unique feel with “signs of NPC’s” that give the feel of a home or building being lived in. The idea being that there’s more of a sense of realism to these locations. GTA 6 will launch for PS5 and Xbox Series consoles on November 19, with a PC release rumored to come out six to seven months later .

articles.chapeau: In the 29th season of "South Park," several of the show
articles.txt:
Paramount Add SVG on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Ever since the release of the final trailer for "Grand Theft Auto 6," Rockstar Games has ground the marketing for its newest game to a halt. While some real-life promotions are happening in Miami, Florida, Rockstar seems content to let "GTA 6" speak for itself when it launches on November 19, 2026. However, one final piece of marketing recently popped up in one place where no one thought it would.
In the newest episode of the comedy TV show "South Park," which has been temporarily rebranded as "South America," some never-before-seen gameplay of "GTA 6" is on display. The gameplay footage isn't anything revolutionary, but Rockstar's goal with this marketing stunt was likely to drum up even more buzz. At the very least, the footage continues to show just how in-depth the game is, even if that means players have to get their hands a little dirty to experience everything "GTA 6" has to offer.
In the new episode, called "Guinea Pig on a Stick," there's a small portion that shows the main characters in the show gathered around a table to receive an in-person presentation of footage from the game. On a television screen behind her, the presenter showcases real gameplay from "GTA 6" and hypes up its realism.
Rockstar Games While you might be expecting a car chase with police or some kind of drug-related mission to be on display, that's not the case whatsoever. Instead, the presenter shows a scene from Vice City Beach with a dog evacuating its bowels right on the sand and its owner picking it up with a plastic bag. Seeing this, protagonist Jason Duval follows the NPC with the dog and throws something at the back of their head. With the NPC distracted, Jason then picks up the bag of dog poop and promptly slaps the NPC in the face with the bag, making it explode in a violent, smelly mess.
New gameplay from GTA 6 was shown in the latest 'SOUTH PARK' episode. pic.twitter.com/gL2kRKUv2I
Of course, this gameplay pales in comparison to what we've previously seen with "GTA 6," especially in the Netflix Extended Look showcase . At this point, though, the community is likely happy with any new footage that Rockstar shows between now and the game's launch.
Fans originally thought this was another gag by the creators of "South Park," since "GTA 6" has been mentioned frequently in the current season. However, the latest episode's credits specifically say "Grand Theft Auto VI footage courtesy of Rockstar Games," so this looks to be an official piece of marketing by Rockstar, and the dog poop-throwing mechanic will be fully available to players in "GTA 6."
This isn't the first time "South Park" has referenced a new game release by Rockstar. Back in 2018, the show parodied multiple storylines from "Red Dead Redemption 2" shortly after its launch and even showed Cartman buying a copy in a store, using the actual game's cover. However, in the case of "Red Dead Redemption 2," Rockstar didn't officially partner with South Park. Instead, the showrunners showcased the game under the fair use doctrine, which they've done with several other games throughout "South Park" history.

articles.t: GTA 6 Story Length & Total Hours, Explained
articles.chapeau: You already know the GTA 6 price tag will be well worth it, but let's have a closer look at how much content is expected.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has been in development for over 10 years, which means Rockstar Games has packed its new juggernaut with a ridiculous amount of content, some of which could take you eons to see. GTA 6’s story length is long, and that’s just the beginning.
The marketing for GTA 6 , the Netflix Showcase and subsequent trailers and magazine reveals have given us a huge window into Jason and Lucia’s relationship and dynamic. From what we know about the game, we’ve barely scratched the surface.
A key Rockstar Games dev completed a playthrough of Grand Theft Auto 6 in around 80 hours, factoring in story and some side content, which means if you purely focus on the story, it could be closer to 60 or 70 hours.
Rob Nelson, head of development and co-studio head at Rockstar Games , was interviewed by The New York Times, and here’s an interesting excerpt:
“I hope that there will be people that want to get up, have a cup of coffee, shower, get dressed, go out for a little exercise,” Nelson said. His 80-hour play-through of the game in February included the main story and some optional goals with narrative ramifications. Routines can escalate quickly. “Interact with some people, explore, maybe get into some trouble,” he added. “Rob some places, make some money.”
So, let’s dissect this. Roughly 80 hours , with optional content. Even ‘dabbling’ with side content, given how big GTA 6 is, could easily consume a few hours of your playtime.
The story alone will likely be worth the price of admission, and you can’t see it being shorter than 60-70 hours for main missions and nothing else.
Achieving total completion of GTA 6 means anywhere between 100 and 300 hours, based on recent Rockstar titles and everything we’ve read and heard about the game’s size and scope.
Even though it’s always a smaller sample size, HowLongToBeat features player-specific answers about how long they’ve spent on a game. Let’s take GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 as examples.
According to the tens of thousands of player-submitted times, a completion playthrough of GTA 5 (achieving 100%) takes roughly 90 hours, but it could easily be 100+.
Whereas Red Dead Redemption 2 is marked down as 196 hours for a completionist playthrough—again, this figure could be over 200 hours. Could GTA 6 be smaller and less densely packed with activities, collectibles, jobs, and things to do? We’ll find out once reviews drop, but there’s every chance that conquering this mammoth game is going to require several hundred hours of your time.
Are we going over 200 or 300 hours to complete GTA 6 fully? Let us know your thoughts on the Insider Gaming Discord server .

articles.t: GTA 6 may not have watermarked reviews, but some other ‘insane security measures’ are in place
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 reviews will go live on November 18, a day before the game’s release. Media outlets and influencers have received codes, and Rockstar is being extra cautious about the possibility of leaks.
articles.txt:
Earlier this week, it was reported that GTA 6 review copies will have watermarks to identify those responsible in case of any leaks. Turns out that’s not true, but Rockstar still seems to have a solid plan in place to avoid leaks, or if that fails, to identify the leaker.
All the leaks for GTA 6 that Rockstar has failed to curtail have naturally made the studio extremely cautious. It was believed that they’re taking no chances with leaks coming from review copies, so they have watermarked the review copies with the reviewer’s name. Now, Insider Gaming’s Tom Henderson and credible leaker NateTheHate have stated that’s not true.
The latter shared on X that the watermark claim is not true, at least to their knowledge. Henderson also posted on X and stated that after a bit of digging, he found no evidence of this being true, but did state that Rockstar has “some insane security measures in place.” What these measures are exactly, remains unclear.
It’s not surprising for Rockstar to have gone the extra mile to make sure there are no more leaks as the review embargo lifts a day before the game’s release. Recent reports confirmed that media outlets and influencers have received review codes for GTA 6 and that the embargo is November 18. The hype around Justice ‘s previously announced score for the forthcoming Grand Theft Auto VI grows more frantic Thursday (Oct. 29) with the release of the duo’s first-ever collaboration with fellow Frenchman Gesaffelstein .
The seven-minute “Pusher” is exactly what fans would expect from the musical peers, with the cinematic song evoking Justice’s “Stress” and “Generator” along with the throttling percussion that defines the Gesaffelstein oeuvre. With each act bringing its predilection for darkly pummeling synths and pacing fit for an action sequence, its easy to imagine this music in the highly anticipated GTA VI , which arrives Nov. 19.
“Pusher” is the second release from Justice’s original score for the GTA VI soundtrack, following the Oct. 15 release of “Flowers In a Hurricane,” a collaboration with SZA, King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard and Tame Impala. “Flowers In a Hurricane” debuted on the Oct. 31-dated Billboard Hot 100 at No. 62, giving King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard its first hit on the list.
Of working on the score to the forthcoming game, Justice’s Xavier de Rosnay said in a statement, “The scope of the game is so large geographically and thematically that it was clear from the beginning the music would also have to be very broad in terms of emotions, genres and textures. We were given the freedom to explore as many things as we needed to, musically speaking.”

articles.t: 9 Ways to Play GTA 6 at Launch, Ranked by Price | GTA BOOM
articles.chapeau: Playing GTA 6 costs about $80 if you already own a PS5 or Xbox, but climbs toward $1,000 for a new PS5 Pro setup.
articles.txt:
The honest answer to how much Grand Theft Auto VI costs depends entirely on what you already own. If a PlayStation 5 or an Xbox Series X or S is sitting under your TV, you are looking at the price of one game. If you need to buy a console too, the bill runs from a few hundred dollars to around a thousand. The cheapest option on paper is a PS5 you cannot legally buy outside Japan, so the cheapest route, if we're being literal, is to buy the game if you already own the console.
Rockstar Games is selling GTA 6 in two editions . The Standard Edition covers the full campaign and the Ultimate Edition costs about 20 dollars more and adds cosmetic items, extra vehicles and weapons, two exclusive side-mission lines and a set of in-game vendors like a car mod shop, a tattoo parlor and a clothing store. You can get tattoos and customize cars without Ultimate, just not at those specific shops. In the United States that is 79.99 dollars for Standard and 99.99 dollars for Ultimate.
We broke down what each edition includes in full and both come with the same pre-order bonuses if you order before the game comes out on November 19. Also, digital pre-orders unlock a pre-load from November 12, a week early, though nobody gets to play before launch since there is no early access. There is no physical disc for either edition and there is no collector's edition . GTA 6 is also not on Xbox Game Pass at launch. There is no PC version yet either, so consoles are the only way in on day one.
The game itself does not cost the same everywhere and the gap is wider than most people expect. The 79.99 dollar US price sits right in the middle of the pack. Japan, India and South Korea pay noticeably less once you convert the local price, while the United Kingdom, the Eurozone, Australia and Brazil pay more because of taxes. Canada is a touch below the US and South Korea is the cheapest storefront in the world at around 58 dollars for Standard.
South Korea is cheaper still at around 58 dollars for the Standard Edition.
Those gaps make it tempting to buy the game from another country's store, usually Japan, India or South Korea, by setting a console account to that region. It works and can save you real money. It also breaks the terms of service for both PlayStation and Xbox, which forbid misrepresenting your country to get a lower price. Accounts caught may find themselves suspended at any given moment and any store credit on them lost, so you risk the console library you already paid for just to save 20 dollars on one game.
Even if it's Grand Theft Auto we're talking about, that's a losing trade no matter how you look at it.
With that said, GTA 6 runs on the PS5 and the Xbox Series X and Series S, so any current console will play it. The cheapest on paper is the Japan-only PS5 Digital Edition in Midnight Black at 55,000 yen, around 350 dollars, which we covered as the cheapest way in . The catch is that it's only available in Japan, locked to Japanese as its system language, needs a PlayStation Network account set to Japan and you can't import it unless someone local buys it for you. For almost everyone outside Japan the cheapest console they can use is the Xbox Series S at 499.99 dollars, the entry-tier, digital-only machine. From there the ladder climbs through the PS5 and up to the PS5 Pro .
Refurbished and used consoles can undercut every new price here, from around 400 dollars for a Series S, but condition and warranty vary and you never quite know what you are getting.
Refurbished and used consoles can undercut every new price here, but condition and warranty vary and you never quite know what you are getting.
Do not count on bundles to save money either. There is no official GTA 6 console bundle from Sony, Microsoft or Rockstar. Some retailers have started packaging a console with the game themselves and the retailer bundles rarely cost less than buying the two separately.
The fact is, there's really no incentive for anyone to sell GTA 6 for a low price unless they're trying to outsell their competition . GTA historically has maintained its launch pricing for months , years even, so don't bet on holiday discounts.
Ultimately, this is the latest chapter in a long run of price stories we have followed. Sony's global PS5 price increase pushed hardware up right before launch and made GTA 6 more expensive for millions before they had even bought it. Rockstar semble avoir largement puisé dans les mécaniques populaires des serveurs GTA RP pour enrichir son prochain monde ouvert, avec des activités quotidiennes, une gestion plus réaliste des véhicules et de nouvelles interactions entre Jason et Lucia.
Dans le numéro de novembre 2026 du magazine Edge , plusieurs responsables de Rockstar North ont détaillé leur volonté de faire de Leonida un monde dans lequel les joueurs peuvent vivre à leur rythme, sans nécessairement enchaîner les missions principales.
Lors d’une démonstration de 90 minutes sur PS5, Rockstar a présenté plusieurs fonctionnalités destinées à renforcer l’immersion. Les joueurs pourront notamment acheter des cigarettes, boire un café pour améliorer temporairement leur endurance ou consommer un shake protéiné pour bénéficier d’un bonus de santé.
Les déplacements ont également été repensés. GTA 6 proposera des réseaux de bus et de trains fonctionnels, avec des itinéraires et des horaires réguliers. Phil Hooker, responsable du développement, explique d’ailleurs accorder une attention particulière à la ponctualité des transports en commun.
Les véhicules bénéficieront eux aussi de nouvelles mécaniques. Chaque voiture disposera d’une jauge de carburant et d’un indicateur d’état du moteur, obligeant les joueurs à surveiller leur consommation et à passer à la station-service.
Autre nouveauté inspirée de Red Dead Redemption 2 : le coffre des véhicules personnels servira à entreposer les armes que Jason et Lucia ne peuvent pas transporter sur eux.
Enfin, un service baptisé Scooter Bros permettra de faire livrer son véhicule directement à sa position contre une petite somme. Le livreur repartira ensuite sur un scooter.
GTA 6 confirme des transformations physiques et un monde qui réagit vraiment à vos actions
GTA 6 pousse le réalisme jusqu’à simuler la transpiration de ses personnages
Mais cette approche ne concerne pas uniquement les déplacements et les objets. Rockstar a également développé un système permettant de faire évoluer la relation entre Jason et Lucia, représentée par une jauge de proximité à quatre niveaux. Pour renforcer leurs liens, les deux protagonistes pourront partager différentes activités : promenades sur la plage, sorties à vélo, séances de sport ou simples balades en voiture.
Le comportement criminel des joueurs aura également son importance grâce au système de profil criminel. Celui-ci évaluera les méthodes employées, des approches professionnelles et non létales jusqu’aux comportements les plus violents, avec des conséquences sur le déroulement de l’histoire.
Pour autant, GTA 6 ne deviendra pas un simulateur de vie totalement libre. Jason et Lucia resteront des criminels, et il ne sera pas possible d’abandonner leurs activités illégales pour exercer un métier ordinaire.
En revanche, la progression du scénario laissera davantage de place aux initiatives personnelles. Entre deux grandes missions, les joueurs pourront notamment organiser de petits braquages, dévaliser des commerces ou voler des véhicules ciblés pour financer leurs prochaines opérations.

articles.chapeau: Le magazine Edge raconte avoir vu Rob Nelson, co-directeur de Rockstar North, jouer à GTA 6 pendant 90 minutes.
articles.txt:
Un important dossier de 16 pages consacré à GTA 6 dévoile de nouvelles informations. Il est le fruit d’une visite chez Rockstar North, à Édimbourg.
L’auteur n’a pas joué lui-même mais à observé Rob Nelson, co-directeur du studio et responsable du développement, parcourir une version actuelle du jeu pendant environ 90 minutes, sans suivre de scénario préparé.
D’après Edge , la police peut accumuler des informations sur un crime comme l’ apparence du suspect, les vêtements portés, la présence d’un complice, l’arme emportée ou encore les images de vidéosurveillance. Les témoins comptent aussi. Ainsi tenir un fusil à la main peut inquiéter les passants, tandis qu’une arme portée dans le dos provoque une réaction différente.
Ces indices sont importants car il guide les choix du joueur. Il peut selon les circonstances se séparer de son partenaire, changer de tenue ou abandonner son arme. Tout ceci aiderait à brouiller la description transmise aux policiers. Certains véhicules volés pourraient aussi être suivis par un traceur, ce qui obligerait à échapper aux poursuivants avant de rejoindre un receleur.
Le dossier indique que la carte de Leonida serait environ deux fois plus grande que celle de GTA V. Rockstar la compare, en superficie terrestre, à l’ensemble des zones jouables de GTA IV, GTA V et Red Dead Redemption 2. Nous apprenons qu’il y a plus d’intérieurs par rapport aux précédents jeux.
Ce dossier complet est publié gratuitement en ligne sur GamesRadar+ . GTA 6 est toujours annoncé pour le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S. Pour le moment aucune version PC n’est mentionnée dans l’annonce officielle de sortie consultée.

articles.t: La taille de la carte de GTA 6 dévoilée, aussi vaste que trois jeux Rockstar réunis - Dexerto
articles.chapeau: Rockstar révèle l’immensité de la carte de GTA 6 et compare Leonida aux mondes ouverts de ses précédents jeux.
articles.txt:
GTA La taille de la carte de GTA 6 dévoilée, aussi vaste que trois jeux Rockstar réunis par Cyril Pomathiod Publié : 29 oct. 2026, 10:07 Sauvegarder pour plus tard Sauvegarder pour plus tard Rockstar Games Ajouter comme source préférée sur Google Suivre sur Google News À quelques semaines de la sortie de GTA 6 , prévue le 19 novembre 2026, Rockstar Games continue de lever le voile sur son prochain blockbuster. Après les rumeurs et fuites, des révélations officielles quant à la taille du monde ouvert sont enfin là.
Dans un long entretien accordé au magazine Edge, publié le 29 octobre, les développeurs reviennent sur l’immensité de Leonida, dont la carte pourrait d’ailleurs se retrouver dans la boîte des versions physiques du jeu .
Rockstar Games avait déjà confirmé que la carte de GTA 6 serait environ deux fois plus grande que celle de GTA 5. Une augmentation considérable, sachant que Los Santos et le comté de Blaine offraient déjà un vaste terrain de jeu.
Mais dans son entretien avec Edge, le studio va encore plus loin en comparant Leonida à plusieurs de ses précédentes productions. Selon Rockstar, la superficie des terres émergées de GTA 6 serait presque équivalente à celle des cartes jouables de GTA 4, GTA 5 et Red Dead Redemption 2 réunies.
Autrement dit, l’environnement que Jason et Lucia pourront parcourir à pied ou en véhicule représenterait à lui seul une superficie comparable à celle de ces trois immenses mondes ouverts cumulés, sans même compter les étendues d’eau qui entourent Leonida.
Pour l’heure, Rockstar n’a toutefois communiqué aucune superficie officielle en kilomètres carrés. Les différentes estimations qui circulent sur Internet reposent essentiellement sur des reconstitutions réalisées par les fans à partir des bandes-annonces, des captures d’écran et d’autres informations disponibles.
GTA 6 pourrait accueillir Liberty City d’après une fuite de fichiers Rockstar
Quelle est la taille de la carte de GTA 6 ? Ce projet montre son immensité par rapport à GTA 5
GTA 6 confirme des transformations physiques et un monde qui réagit vraiment à vos actions
Contrairement à GTA 5, dont l’action se déroulait principalement à Los Santos et dans les régions rurales environnantes, GTA 6 proposera d’explorer un État entier inspiré de la Floride.
Rockstar a déjà présenté six grandes régions qui composeront Leonida : Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia et le parc national de Mount Kalaga.
Ces environnements offriront des paysages particulièrement variés, entre les gratte-ciel et les plages de Vice City, les îles tropicales de Leonida Keys, les marécages de Grassrivers ou encore les vastes étendues sauvages de Mount Kalaga.
Cette diversité devrait également permettre à Rockstar de multiplier les activités et les possibilités d’exploration, sur terre, sur l’eau et dans les airs.
Si les dimensions de Leonida impressionnent, Rockstar insiste surtout sur la densité de son monde ouvert.
Aaron Garbut, codirecteur de Rockstar North et responsable du développement, explique notamment que GTA 6 contiendra un nombre d’intérieurs explorables d’un tout autre ordre de grandeur, environ dix fois supérieur à celui des précédents jeux du studio.
Les développeurs ont accordé une attention particulière aux bâtiments, aux ruelles, aux toits et aux différents espaces qui composent l’environnement. Les habitations ne seront pas simplement des pièces vides, mais des lieux qui racontent quelque chose de leurs occupants.
Garbut affirme même qu’après plusieurs années passées à explorer Leonida pendant le développement, il lui arrive encore de découvrir des endroits qu’il n’avait jamais visités.
L’objectif de Rockstar semble donc clair : proposer non seulement sa plus grande carte à ce jour, mais également un monde ouvert suffisamment riche pour encourager les joueurs à en explorer chaque recoin. Néanmoins, ces ambitions démesurées pourraient également se ressentir sur le stockage des consoles, puisqu’ une récente fuite évoque un poids de 210 Go pour GTA 6 sur PS5 .

articles.t: South Park GTA 6 Clip: 17 Seconds Reported [2026]
articles.chapeau: South Park GTA 6 clip: what the dog poop beach scene shows, what is confirmed, and why the real-gameplay claim and 17-second length stay unproven.
articles.txt:
· Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
South Park put a sliver of Grand Theft Auto VI on television, or something close to it, and the gaming press has spent the past day arguing over what it means. Notebookcheck reported that the episode titled “Guinea Pig on a Stick” shows Jason and Lucia on a packed Vice City beach , where a bagged pile of dog waste turns into a melee weapon. That is the core of the story. Everything around it needs careful handling.
This analysis separates what the available reports confirm from what they only assert. The gap matters because several fan sites call the footage real, official gameplay, while the evidence behind this article treats that point as unestablished. No on-record statement from Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, Comedy Central, or the South Park creators appears in any report we reviewed.
The stakes run deeper than a gross-out gag. GTA VI already carries one of the heaviest expectation loads in the industry, and our earlier look at Circana’s record 29% purchase intent shows how much audience attention sits behind every scrap of footage. When a cartoon with a reputation for quick turnaround shows even a few seconds of that world, search demand follows. Phrases like South Park GTA 6 and GTA 6 dog poop scene are now the entry point for readers who missed the broadcast.
Below, we walk through the confirmed facts, test the authenticity claim, map how outlets framed the story, and weigh the market impact. We also compare reveal channels, give historical context, and offer five predictions. Where we reason beyond the sourced facts, we say so.
Start with what the reports agree on. The episode is titled “Guinea Pig on a Stick.” It includes footage that depicts Jason and Lucia on a crowded Vice City beach. In that footage, a dog owner bags dog feces, then Jason picks up the bag and uses it against an NPC. Reports describe the throw and the melee hit as part of one sequence.
A character in the episode also explains the mechanic out loud: players can pick up dog feces, throw it at another person, and use it to attack them. That narration matters, because it frames the gag as a description of a game system rather than a one-off animation. Whether the system exists as a repeatable feature is a separate question, and no source in our review answers it.
The visible action is simple. Two playable characters stand among beachgoers. A dog does its business, its owner bags the result, and Jason grabs the bag. He then swings or throws it at a nearby non-player character. Outlets that covered the clip, including Notebookcheck and Vice , centered their write-ups on this chain of events.
Four items stay open. Nobody has independently established that the footage is real or officially supplied GTA VI gameplay. The 17-second length comes from one source only. The phrase “flying dog poop” is a descriptive headline choice, and no official product statement confirms that wording or mechanic. And no verified on-record quote from the companies or creators exists in the reports.
The headline-grabbing claim is that South Park aired genuine GTA VI gameplay. Several outlets and fan sites state this flatly. RockstarINTEL, GTA BOOM, and Droidfeats all lead with versions of the real-footage framing. None of those headlines amounts to independent confirmation, because the reports we reviewed include no company source.
A fair reading is that fan sites judge the footage by how well it fits what they expect from the game. That is an impression, not proof. Fan communities are fast at pattern matching, and they are also fast at accepting a clip that fits what they hope to see. Parody animation, a licensed capture, and a stylized re-creation can all resemble one another on a television screen after compression.
Deadline took a more cautious editorial posture in its headline, describing the segment as a parody of GTA VI with dog poop gameplay. The Hollywood Reporter folded it into a recap of the episode and called it a sneak peek. Those choices show that even mainstream entertainment outlets disagree on how much weight the clip deserves. We follow the cautious reading until a company says otherwise.
There is one practical test. If Rockstar supplied the footage, a statement, a credit, or a matching clip on its own channels would likely follow. If the show built the sequence itself, nothing will follow.

articles.txt:

GTA 6 is shaping up to be the biggest video game launch in history, and it seems the game itself could be massive in more ways than one. With its November 19 release date inching closer, a new leak has now revealed how much storage space players may need to set aside, and the figure is significantly higher than Rockstar’s previous games.
According to PlayStation Game Size on X, which tracks information found through the PlayStation Store backend, the standard edition of GTA 6 will reportedly require around 210 GB of storage on PS5. Rockstar hasn’t officially confirmed the figure yet, so it should still be treated as a leak for now. The Xbox Series X/S install size also remains unknown, although it could end up being somewhere around the same size.
🚨 Grand Theft Auto VI – 𝐃𝐨𝐰𝐧𝐥𝐨𝐚𝐝 𝐒𝐢𝐳𝐞 : 210 GB – 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐫𝐝 ($79.99) Pre-Load : November 12 Release : November 19 𝐑𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐞 : Midnight pic.twitter.com/5vXkgnqfC7
If accurate, 210 GB would make GTA 6 one of the largest major games around. For comparison, Red Dead Redemption 2 required 99 GB on PS4 and 107 GB on Xbox One at launch (according to reports at the time), meaning Rockstar’s next game could take up more than twice as much space. Other major releases such as Assassin’s Creed Valhalla and Stalker 2 have been around the 160 GB mark, while Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War has also reached roughly 175 GB.
Of course, a larger installation doesn’t automatically mean GTA 6 will offer twice as much content as a smaller game. File sizes can be affected by everything from textures and audio to cinematics and how developers compress game data. Still, a 210 GB requirement wouldn’t be too surprising considering the scale Rockstar appears to be targeting.
GTA 6 is expected to feature a huge open world filled with detailed environments, characters, vehicles, interiors, activities, and other content. Its map has also been reported to be considerably larger than Red Dead Redemption 2’s, so all of that content will naturally require plenty of storage.
Thankfully, players won’t have to download everything on launch day. Preloading is scheduled to begin on November 12, giving buyers a full week to install the game before its November 19 release.

articles.t: New GTA 6 Gameplay Was Shown on South Park, and It Totally Stinks
articles.chapeau: Poop physics!
articles.txt:
Has any game ever been as hotly anticipated as Rockstar’s Grand Theft Auto 6 ? We sincerely doubt it. Fans have analyzed every name rumored to be attached to GTA 6 , and calls for more gameplay and content are at an all-time high on social media like Reddit and X, despite the massive amount of leaks that have already shown big portions of the game.
With less than a month until GTA 6 launches, Rockstar has decided to give gamers a new exclusive clip, revealed during the latest South Park — or rather, South America — episode on Comedy Central.
Image: Comedy Central/Rockstar Games In the episode "Beef Battle," which aired on Oct. 28, a woman stands off to one side and plays a GTA 6 clip on a TV. We see a German Shepherd defecate, then walk off, leaving its owner to pick up the dog poop. Co-protagonists Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval walk behind the dog and its owner.
“You can throw things at the person with dog poop,” the woman explains, as the clip shows Jason doing just that. The owner drops the dog feces he’s carrying, allowing Jason to pick up the mess and then attack the owner with it.
You may think this clip sounds like a perfect S outh Park spoof made up by the show’s creators, but the episode's end credits confirm the footage is real, and Rockstar provided it.
The clip is plenty ludicrous, though anyone familiar with the franchise won’t be surprised. It does, however, show just how much thought and detail Rockstar has put into its latest game, which is already shaping up to be one hell of an ambitious title.
GTA 6 characters Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval Rockstar Games We doubt picking up poop will be the only silly detail GTA 6 has. Previous Rockstar games like Red Dead Redemption 2 had horse testicle physics , after all. Given that GTA 6 's world promises to be the densest and most detailed to ever appear in a game, picking up and throwing dog poop doesn't seem so implausible. It will probably get less attention than other details like mud physics and NPC dialogue systems , of course.
Still, the reveal of dog poop gameplay probably wasn’t what fans had in mind when asking for more gameplay clips from the developers.

articles.t: South Park airs GTA 6 gameplay with flying dog poop on packed Vice City beach
articles.chapeau: South Park has referenced Rockstar’s upcoming title in various gags. The latest episode includes a GTA 6 gameplay clip featuring Jason and Lucia on a beach. A dog poop fight unfolds on a teeming beachfront that hilariously demonstrates advanced graphics.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games has premiered GTA 6 gameplay through YouTube videos or, in one case, the Netflix Extended Look . Still, a new clip surfaced in an unexpected place. In the latest South Park episode, Jason and Lucia emerge on a crowded Vice City beach . The footage involves Jason hurling dog poop at a seemingly random NPC .
Early in the clip from "Guinea Pig on a Stick", the narrator explains that beachgoers can bag their canine’s poop. However, it can also become a weapon , as is evident when Lucia’s partner throws the excrement at an unsuspecting man. Not surprisingly, the victim is agitated, but Jason proceeds to repeat the attack anyway.
At first, it was unclear whether the GTA 6 gameplay sequence was authentic and provided by Rockstar. Even so, the level of detail matches that seen in official trailers. To put any doubt to rest, the credits after the South Park episode read, “Grand Theft Auto VI footage courtesy of Rockstar Games, Inc.”
It’s debatable if the animated sitcom has a marketing deal with the studio. Regardless, the dog poop video is only the most recent time the show mentioned the project. During a September 16th EP called "South American Biker Gangs", the characters believe the GTA 6 release date will improve the country.
In the September 30th South Park EP, there are concerns that a power outage could prevent players from saving their progress. On October 14th, a sign advertising the title appeared in reference to upcoming elections. GTA 6 will likely continue to play a role in the show as its launch approaches.
Jokes aside, the gameplay clip is as much of a technical showcase as earlier trailers. Throngs of NPCs with unique body shapes line the Vice City beach, stressing the CPUs of Xbox and PS5 consoles . At least some of the individuals react to Jason’s violence or gentler contact with dialogue. The visual fidelity also impresses, including dynamic footprints on the stand.

articles.t: GTA 6 pourrait proposer plus de 200 missions principales, selon le décompte partagé par un leaker
articles.chapeau: Le 19 novembre marque la sortie de GTA 6 sur les consoles PS5 et Xbox Series. Ce sera l’un des plus grands jeux de tous les temps, si ce n’est le plus grand, non seulement en matière de budget, mais aussi de gameplay.
articles.txt:
À moins de trois semaines de sa sortie, l’engouement pour GTA 6 n’a jamais été aussi fort. Nous savons que le jeu sera gigantesque, tant par son ampleur que par la taille du jeu . Aujourd’hui, une nouvelle fuite a révélé le nombre de missions qui feront partie de l’ histoire principale , et bien plus encore.
L’information provient de remus_r sur X et affirme que GTA 6 proposera 201 missions pour l’histoire principale, deux prologues, un épilogue et plusieurs flashbacks, le tout réparti sur neuf chapitres au total. Cela fait beaucoup de missions rien que pour l’histoire, ce qui semble peu crédible.
Dans les commentaires, l’auteur précise que le nombre de 201 correspond uniquement aux missions de l’histoire principale et que les quêtes annexes, les rencontres, etc. ne sont pas incluses dans ce total. Certains internautes ont également émis des doutes sur les affirmations de remus_r, car elles ne s’appuient sur aucune source. Le profil X de l’auteur de la fuite ne compte que cinq publications, toutes liées à GTA 6 . Il a également publié un message il y a quelques jours (le 26 octobre) concernant la taille du jeu, affirmant qu’il pèserait 230 Go. Maintenant qu’il a été révélé que le jeu pèserait 210 Go, l’auteur de la fuite a précisé qu’il atteindrait 230 Go après le patch du premier jour. Cela semble également peu probable.
Quant aux deux prologues, il se dit que les joueurs pourront découvrir séparément les débuts des histoires de Jason et de Lucia. C’est ce qu’indique l’un des commentaires sous la publication . Concernant les flashbacks, nous savons que Jason a un passé militaire, et quelques scènes de la récente bande-annonce de lancement le montraient en tenue militaire. Elles pourraient faire partie d’un flashback, mais il est impossible de le confirmer à ce stade.

Neither Rockstar Games nor Take-Two Interactive has confirmed the GTA 6 file size, and we covered the leak itself in our earlier piece on the 210 GB download size leak . This article takes a different angle: what the number means for the storage you already own, how long the download takes, and how to plan the week between pre-load and launch.

The source is PlayStation Game Size, an X account that tracks upcoming releases. Complex reported on October 27 that the account determines install sizes by reading the PlayStation Store backend. Its listing for Grand Theft Auto VI put the standard edition at 210 GB, with pre-load on November 12 and release on November 19. Complex also noted the account listed a midnight release time.
The Scotsman, which published its explainer on October 28, described the account as one that has proven accurate before, while stressing the number is far from confirmed. GameSpot ran a similar report and framed it the same way: PlayStation Game Size says the $80 standard edition will take 210 GB. Notebookcheck added that the figure equals about a quarter of the available space on a standard PS5.
That is four outlets repeating one upstream claim, so treat the agreement as a single data point. Still, the account’s track record and the fact that the figure matches earlier talk of a very large build make 210 GB a reasonable planning number.
The firm facts come from the publisher. In its pre-order announcement , Take-Two said Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S at $79.99. The release also lists the Ultimate Edition at $99.99.
On storage logistics, the same release is explicit. Players who pre-order a digital version can begin pre-loading on November 12, 2026. The physical version contains a download code inside the box and becomes available from November 12 to support pre-loading. Our rundown of what is confirmed about the November 19 launch tracks the rest of the checklist.
Three questions stay open. The Scotsman points out that the 210 GB figure applies only to the standard PS5 edition, with nothing on the pricier Ultimate Edition. It also says nobody knows the Xbox Series X|S size, though it is likely similar to the PS5 build, and nobody knows whether a day-one patch will be required.
Complex went further and wrote that the tracker pegged the game at 210 GB on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. GameSpot and The Scotsman, by contrast, say the Xbox size is unknown but probably close. We side with the cautious reading. A store listing for the game exists on Microsoft’s Xbox store , but no outlet we checked has quoted an official Xbox install size from it.
The day-one patch matters most for planning. Pre-load packages often update again at launch. If Rockstar ships a patch, the total footprint on November 19 could exceed 210 GB, and the console may need temporary working space while it installs. No outlet has put a number on this, so any figure you see online is a guess.
Raw drive capacity overstates what you can use. System software, the operating system cache and your existing library all take a share. The Scotsman puts the original PS5 at around 667 GB of usable storage at launch, with 1 TB on the Slim and 2 TB on the Pro. Mashable describes the base PS5 as having a little less than 1 TB of usable space, so outlets disagree on the original model. We use the lower, more conservative figure.
The percentages are our arithmetic. For everything except the original PS5 we divided by advertised capacity, so the real share is higher once system files are subtracted.
Original PS5 owners face the toughest squeeze. At roughly 31% of usable space, one game eats close to a third of the drive. Notebookcheck noted that PS5 Pro owners should feel more comfortable with their 2 TB drive. Slim owners sit in the middle and can likely keep GTA 6 alongside two or three other large installs.

articles.t: Rockstar Games says GTA 6 leaks were emotionally invasive and difficult to handle
articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games explains how the 2022 GTA 6 leaks affected developers emotionally and led to stricter security and office working policies.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games explains how the 2022 GTA 6 leaks affected developers emotionally and led to stricter security and office working policies.
Rockstar Games has described the 2022 Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks as an emotionally difficult, deeply invasive experience, revealing how the incident influenced the studio’s security measures and work policies. The unauthorised release of unfinished gameplay footage exposed material that developers had never intended the public to see, prompting changes to how the company protects its highly anticipated game.
Aaron Garbut, co-head of development at Rockstar Games, discussed the incident in a Bloomberg interview covering the lengthy development of GTA 6. His comments offer insight into the breach’s personal impact and the challenges the studio has faced while protecting one of the gaming industry’s most closely watched projects.
In September 2022, a hacker accessed Rockstar Games’ internal Slack communications and released dozens of videos showing unfinished GTA 6 gameplay. The footage spread rapidly across social media and gaming websites, revealing early details about the game well before Rockstar was ready to present it officially.
The incident attracted widespread attention because GTA 6 was already one of the most anticipated video games in development. The leaked material offered an early look at gameplay systems, environments, and character interactions, though it was an incomplete version of the project. Rockstar later issued a public statement acknowledging the breach and expressing disappointment that the game’s details had been shared this way.
The company pursued copyright takedowns to limit the circulation of the footage. However, the material had already spread widely online, making it difficult to contain. Law enforcement later tracked down the alleged hacker, but the public disclosure had already done its damage.
Garbut explained that the experience was particularly uncomfortable because it exposed work that developers considered private and unfinished. “It feels like somebody’s wading through your dirty washing,” he said. “It’s like they’re inside your head. You see your early work out there. Nobody’s ever supposed to see that. It’s really weirdly invasive. And so it’s quite hard to deal with on an emotional level.”
His remarks highlight a different side of major game leaks. While players may welcome early footage and details about upcoming releases, developers can view the unauthorised publication of their work as a serious intrusion. Early development material often lacks the polish, visual quality, and final presentation expected of a completed game, and its sudden exposure can pressure the studio before it’s ready to share its progress.
The leak contributed to a broader reassessment of security at Rockstar Games. In 2024, the company introduced a policy requiring developers to work from the office five days a week. The move aimed to strengthen security by limiting access to sensitive development resources and reducing the risks of remote work.
Under the policy, developers were also restricted from accessing Rockstar’s servers and tools outside the office. The arrangement created practical difficulties for employees who needed to stay home because of childcare responsibilities or emergencies, with some reportedly having to use holiday leave when they could not attend work.
The decision also raised concerns about working conditions at the studio. After releasing Red Dead Redemption 2, Rockstar faced criticism for demanding development schedules and long periods of crunch, during which employees worked long hours to meet production deadlines. The company subsequently faced expectations to adopt more sustainable working practices for future projects.
The return to full-time office attendance appeared to reverse some progress toward flexible working arrangements. Although Rockstar has emphasised the importance of protecting GTA 6, the policy has created a difficult balance between safeguarding valuable intellectual property and accommodating employees’ personal circumstances.
Jennifer Kolbe, Rockstar’s head of publishing, told Bloomberg that the company intends to reconsider its working arrangements after GTA 6 launches. However, she suggested that returning to a conventional hybrid model, in which employees spend three days in the office and two days working remotely, might not be straightforward.
